title: IFR practice on the Phoenix ILS 07L

items.prompt: Find ZINGA on the ILS 07L plate, then select that fix on the 3D map.
items.explanation: ZINGA sits on the final approach course between FOWLE and Runway 07L. Use the fix labels to match the plate to the 3D route.

items.prompt: Read the plate's profile view. What altitude is printed at ZINGA?
items.explanation: The profile prints 2,600 ft MSL at ZINGA. The reveal turns on the map labels so you can find that altitude on the 3D route.

items.prompt: Follow the published missed approach on the plate. Which fix is named for the hold?
items.explanation: The missed approach leads to the PXR VORTAC for the hold. The fixes west of the runway are on the inbound side of the procedure.

items.prompt: Follow the final approach course to Phoenix Sky Harbor. Select the Runway 07L threshold marked RW07L.
items.explanation: RW07L marks the approach end of Runway 07L. The airport diagram shows the runway beneath the final approach course.
